title: Assessing reversible and irreversible binding effects of kinase covalent inhibitors through ADP-Glo assays
author: Schröder, Chaikuad

steps.title: Dilute JNK3 to 20 µM
steps.instruction: Dilute recombinant JNK3 in protein storage buffer to a final concentration of 20 µM in a total volume of 15 mL.

steps.title: Add inhibitor and incubate
steps.instruction: Add covalent inhibitor Fmu‑001‑367 to the JNK3 solution to reach a final concentration of 30 µM and incubate on ice for 2 h (optional LC/MS verification of adduct formation).

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL of the reaction with 95 µL of 0.1 % formic acid.
Inject 1 µL into an Agilent 6230 TOF mass spectrometer equipped with a 300SB‑C3 column.
Deconvolute the m/z spectra with MassHunter BioConfirm; a single adduct mass equal to protein + inhibitor indicates complete reaction.

steps.title: Concentrate adduct
steps.instruction: Concentrate the reaction mixture to 500 µL using a 30‑kDa cutoff Amicon® Ultra centrifugal concentrator; spin any precipitate at 15,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Purify adduct by SEC
steps.instruction: Purify the concentrated adduct by size‑exclusion chromatography on an Äkta system using a Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column pre‑equilibrated with protein storage buffer.

steps.title: Concentrate purified adduct
steps.instruction: Concentrate the purified JNK3‑Fmu‑001‑367 adduct to 300 µM (10× substrate stock) with a 30‑kDa cutoff concentrator; determine concentration by absorbance at 280 nm unless the inhibitor absorbs at this wavelength, in which case use an alternative method such as a Bradford assay.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze substrate
steps.instruction: Flash‑freeze the 10× cov‑JNK3 substrate in 50 µL aliquots and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw ADP‑Glo reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw all ADP‑Glo assay reagents; keep 10 mM ultra‑pure ATP on ice and keep the remaining reagents at 22‑25 °C.

steps.title: Thaw kinases and spin
steps.instruction: Quick‑thaw MKK7 kinase and the 10× cov‑JNK3 substrate, centrifuge each at high speed for 10 min at 4 °C, transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare 10× MKK7 solution
steps.instruction: Dilute MKK7 kinase in protein storage buffer to 250 nM (75 µL total, 10×) and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixtures
steps.instruction: Prepare three master mixes on ice: (a) Mixture 1 – 1 part 10× MKK7, 1 part 10× cov‑JNK3 substrate, 8 parts reaction buffer (e.g., 500 µL total = 50 µL each component + 450 µL buffer); (b) Mixture 2 – 1 part protein storage buffer, 1 part 10× cov‑JNK3 substrate, 8 parts buffer (e.g., 50 µL total = 5 µL each + 45 µL buffer); (c) Mixture 3 – 1 part 10× MKK7, 1 part protein storage buffer, 8 parts buffer (e.g., 50 µL total = 5 µL each + 45 µL buffer). Keep all mixtures on ice.

steps.title: Create inhibitor dilution series
steps.instruction: In a 384‑well Echo® source plate, add 25 µL of 5 mM inhibitor stock (in DMSO) to three separate wells for each inhibitor and 30 µL DMSO to a fourth well; use the Echo 550 acoustic liquid handler with the “Dose response” program and DMSO backfill to generate two intermediate dilutions and dispense the appropriate volumes into assay‑plate wells, delivering 50 nL of inhibitor or DMSO to each well so that the final DMSO concentration is 1 %.

steps.title: Add reaction mixtures to assay plate
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, add 4.9 µL of the appropriate mixture to each well: Mixture 2 to “Control No kinase” wells, Mixture 3 to “Control No substrate” wells, and Mixture 1 to all inhibitor wells and the three “Control DMSO only” wells. Perform the transfers rapidly, completing all control wells first.

steps.title: Pre‑incubate kinase reactions
steps.instruction: Shake the plate briefly (500 × g, 15 s) and incubate at 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Add ATP
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 nL of 10 mM ultra‑pure ATP into every well with the Echo 550 (Plate reformat program) to achieve a final ATP concentration of 0.1 mM.

steps.title: Incubate after ATP addition
steps.instruction: Shake briefly, then incubate the plate at 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add ADP‑Glo reagent
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of ADP‑Glo Reagent to each well, mix by shaking, and incubate at 22‑25 °C for 40 min.

steps.title: Add kinase detection reagent
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of Kinase Detection Reagent to each well, mix by shaking, and incubate at 22‑25 °C for a further 40 min.

steps.title: Measure luminescence
steps.instruction: Read luminescence on a PheraStar FSX (or equivalent) plate reader; adjust gain based on the “Control No kinase” wells or use appropriate filters to avoid detector saturation.

steps.title: Calculate IC50 and assay quality
steps.instruction: Plot luminescence (Y) versus log inhibitor concentration (X), optionally normalize to “Control DMSO only” and “Control No kinase”, fit a four‑parameter logistic curve (e.g., in GraphPad Prism) to obtain IC50 values, and compute Z′ factor using control‑well statistics.

steps.title: Prepare reagents for no‑preincubation assay
steps.instruction: Thaw ADP‑Glo reagents, MKK7 kinase and 10× cov‑JNK3 substrate as in steps 7‑9 and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixtures (no‑preincubation)
steps.instruction: Prepare Mixture 1, Mixture 2 and Mixture 3 as described in step 10 and keep on ice.

steps.title: Create inhibitor series (no‑preincubation)
steps.instruction: Generate the same serial dilutions of inhibitors in the 384‑well plate using the Echo 550 as described in step 11.

steps.title: Add ATP before mixtures
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 nL of 10 mM ATP into all wells to reach a final concentration of 0.1 mM (Echo 550).

steps.title: Add reaction mixtures after ATP
steps.instruction: Immediately add 4.9 µL of the appropriate mixture to each well (Mixture 2 to “Control No kinase”, Mixture 3 to “Control No substrate”, Mixture 1 to inhibitor and DMSO control wells) using a multichannel pipette, completing transfers quickly.

steps.title: Incubate kinase reactions
steps.instruction: Shake briefly and incubate at 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add ADP‑Glo reagent (no‑preincubation)
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL ADP‑Glo Reagent to each well, mix, and incubate at 22‑25 °C for 40 min.

steps.title: Add detection reagent (no‑preincubation)
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Kinase Detection Reagent, mix, and incubate at 22‑25 °C for 40 min.

steps.title: Measure luminescence (no‑preincubation)
steps.instruction: Read luminescence as in step 18.

steps.title: Determine IC50 (no‑preincubation)
steps.instruction: Analyze data identically to step 19 to obtain IC50 values and Z′ factor.
